title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to launch Spyglass, our powerful new tool, making it fully available to all users after a successful beta phase.

title: Intuitive File Management
summary: Our enhanced editor now features comprehensive file management, enabling you to effortlessly organize, upload, link, and customize the appearance of all your images and documents.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We're excited to introduce our new public roadmap, providing a clear, dynamic view of our recently shipped updates, what's next, and our long-term vision.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Experience a smoother workflow with our newly designed checkboxes that are now easier to click, draggable, and seamlessly integrated into our modern user interface.

title: Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience streamlined collaboration with clearer insights into shared work and effortless real-time co-editing.

title: Effortless Collaboration & Discovery
summary: We've significantly improved your ability to share and collaborate on ideas and quests, making all relevant content from your network effortlessly discoverable and visible.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Noeko's codebase is now fully open source, empowering our community with maximum control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in shaping its future.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce comprehensive support for international languages, connecting users across the globe.

title: Personalize Your Workspace with Stunning New Themes
summary: Transform your visual experience with beautifully polished existing themes and an exciting array of vibrant new styles to perfectly match your aesthetic.

title: Smarter Knowledge Graph
summary: Experience a more intelligent and interactive knowledge graph, empowering you to effortlessly explore connections and kickstart your workflows with powerful new filtering and sharing capabilities.

title: Powerful Search Filters & Custom Views
summary: Efficiently narrow down your knowledge with robust filtering and sorting options, and instantly access your most relevant information by saving customized search views.

title: Flexible Note Organization
summary: Organize your notes more intuitively with flexible display options for linked content, allowing you to see exactly what you need, when you need it.

title: Noeko Goes Public: Self-Hosting and Premium Plans Arrive
summary: Experience the next evolution of Noeko with flexible self-hosting options and premium plans, empowering you to choose how you deploy and unlock advanced capabilities.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized experience as we update your in-app greetings to accurately reflect the exact time of day wherever you are.

title: Effortless Tag Management
summary: We're making it simpler than ever to organize your content by enabling quick and easy removal of items from tags directly within the tag list view.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Broaden your insights by seamlessly integrating diverse content formats like YouTube videos, websites, and text files directly into your workspace.
